prompts.complete:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: provisional transparent PNG game asset for a native RPG Maker MZ visual novel, the COMPLETE MAP from a coordinated three-image set.
Primary request: a single hand-drawn parchment map, seen perfectly flat from above, showing two incomplete paths coming together to reveal the entrance to a small abandoned village. This complete map will be the fixed registration reference for a dwarven map piece and an elven map piece generated afterward.
Composition: square 1024 x 1024 canvas. Keep the entire parchment within a centered 800 x 800 area, with generous fully transparent margins. A small old church is drawn in the upper left quadrant; an ancient fig tree is drawn in the upper right quadrant; the revealed ruined village with its council house is below the center. These three landmarks and connecting path lines are the only geographical symbols. The paths cross at the village entrance. Keep clear, simple shapes readable when scaled down to 450 pixels.
Style: black pen-and-ink contours, restrained crosshatching, muted aged beige parchment, slightly irregular paper edges. The left half has angular dwarven stonework border motifs; the right half has delicate elven root and branch border motifs. Both belong to the same sheet. A subtle sepia ink emphasis identifies the village entrance. This is an illustrative prop, not a screen or interface.
Constraints: exactly one complete map sheet, orthographic and unrotated. Actual transparent background outside the parchment, preserving alpha; no painted checkerboard, surrounding table, hands, drop shadow, UI, text, letters, numbers, runes, compass labels, watermarks, people, weapons or extra landmarks. Artwork is provisional and must not imply additional story decisions.
prompts.dwarven:
Use case image-edit; provisional native visual-novel game asset.
Create the DWARVEN FRAGMENT from the supplied completed map. Preserve exactly the input square canvas dimensions, scale, registration, unrotated orthographic view and coordinates of every retained line. Do not recenter or zoom the content.
Keep only the left parchment region with its angular border, church and incomplete path. Remove all the right-side parchment/tree/elven border to true transparency. Tear away an irregular diagonal region through the lower-center village so the village entrance and path intersection are entirely absent; the lower torn edge ends before that entrance. The retained church and path stay exactly at their existing positions. The resulting left fragment should occupy the same left upper part of the original full-map canvas, with the rest fully transparent. Include a small irregular strip along the central upper seam for overlap with the future right fragment. Do not draw new geography, a second church, labels, text, symbols or any replacement content. Maintain original ink and beige paper; no painted checkerboard, shadows, table or hands. This is one fragment, not a complete map.
prompts.dwarven_alpha: Edit this dwarven parchment fragment image ONLY to replace the gray-and-white checkerboard outside the torn paper with actual transparent alpha pixels. Output an RGBA PNG with genuine transparent background. The checkerboard is NOT artwork and MUST NOT be painted into the output. Preserve the parchment, every ink line and all paper pixels, same square canvas and precise position/scale. No resizing, recentering, new drawing or changes to the fragment. Outside the paper including the entire right half is transparent, alpha=0.
prompts.elven: Generate one transparent PNG game asset: the ELVEN MAP FRAGMENT, a torn-off right portion of the supplied parchment map. Use real transparency outside the fragment, preserving alpha like the supplied image. Keep the supplied 1254 by 1254 square canvas and the exact scale and coordinates of all retained paper and drawings. Keep the fig tree in the upper right and the branch ornament along the right edge. Remove the entire left side, church and angular border. An irregular torn inner edge descends from approximately x620 at the top to x920 at the bottom, removing the village entrance and central path intersection so this piece alone does not reveal the entrance. The retained path ends at the torn edge. No recentering, crop, rotation, labels, text, new geography, people or shadows. Output only this single right-side parchment fragment on alpha-transparent empty canvas.
prompts.dwarven_final: Generate one transparent PNG game asset: the DWARVEN MAP FRAGMENT, a torn-off left portion of the first supplied parchment map. The second image is its already prepared right-side companion: match that companion's real transparency and coordinate registration. Keep the first supplied 1254 by 1254 square canvas and exact scale and coordinates of all retained paper and drawings. Keep only the church in the upper left and the angular ornament along the left edge. Remove the entire right side, fig tree and branch border. An irregular torn inner edge descends from approximately x650 at the top to x350 at the bottom, removing the village entrance and central path intersection so this piece alone does not reveal the entrance. The retained path ends at the torn edge. No recentering, crop, rotation, labels, text, new geography, people or shadows. Output only this single LEFT-side parchment fragment on real alpha-transparent empty canvas, as in the second reference.
prompts.dwarven_short: Create an RGBA PNG with transparent background. Keep only the LEFT torn parchment fragment with the church and angular left border from this map. Erase the fig tree and everything to the right of the central tear, including the village entrance. Preserve the existing size, position and line art of the retained left fragment on the original square canvas.

note: Dwarven attempts 1–3 contained an opaque checkerboard and were rejected. A fourth edit from the complete-map reference produced true RGBA. No local background-removal script was used. Native transforms align the shared 1254-square canvas, and receipt transforms center each visible fragment.
